About Me

I'm Harshit Poudel, from Narayanghat, Chitwan, Nepal. I enjoy traveling and riding, discovering new places, experiencing different vibes, and trying things I've never done before. I also love gaming a lot. Whenever I come across something new, I like researching it and understanding it better. For me, life is about exploring, enjoying the moment, and collecting random memories that become good stories later.
